claims: The 98th Academy Awards took place on March 15, 2026.
Sinners won four Oscars at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners received a record-breaking 16 nominations at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sinners won Best Actor for Michael B. Jordan.
Sinners won Best Original Screenplay for Ryan Coogler.
Sinners won Best Cinematography for Autumn Durald Arkapaw.
Sinners won Best Original Score for Ludwig Göransson.
Autumn Durald Arkapaw was the first woman to win in the Best Cinematography category.
Sinners lost Best Picture to One Battle After Another.
Sinners lost Best Director to One Battle After Another
